item.title: Litestream Ventures secures $78m in investor pledges at Davos forum
item.description: Litestream Ventures recorded $78m in non-binding investor pledges during the World Economic Forum, debuting new pledge-based signalling technology to back companies tackling global challenges. Read more: Litestream Ventures secures $78m in investor pledges at Davos forum

item.title: Liz Kendall unveils AI ‘Future of Work’ unit and pledge to upskill 10 million workers by 2030
item.description: Science and Technology Secretary Liz Kendall has announced a new cross-government Future of Work Unit, a £27m TechLocal programme and plans to upskill 10 million workers in AI by 2030. Read more: Liz Kendall unveils AI ‘Future of Work’ unit and pledge to upskill 10 million workers by 2030

item.title: Lanarkshire named latest AI Growth Zone with 3,400 jobs and £8.2bn investment boost
item.description: Lanarkshire has been announced as Scotland’s first AI Growth Zone, creating more than 3,400 jobs and attracting £8.2bn in private investment alongside targeted cost-of-living support for local communities. Read more: Lanarkshire named latest AI Growth Zone with 3,400 jobs and £8.2bn investment boost

item.title: Pornhub to block UK access for new users amid age-verification row
item.description: Pornhub will restrict access for UK users from 2 February, blocking new visitors and citing the Online Safety Act’s age-verification rules as ineffective, as regulator Ofcom disputes the claim. Read more: Pornhub to block UK access for new users amid age-verification row

item.title: Royal Mail delivered Christmas post late to 16 million people, Citizens Advice finds
item.description: Royal Mail delivered letters and parcels late to around 16 million people over Christmas, up 50% on last year, prompting warnings from Citizens Advice that consumers face “no light at the end of the tunnel”. Read more: Royal Mail delivered Christmas post late to 16 million people, Citizens Advice finds

item.title: Poundland owner Gordon Brothers buys LK Bennett out of administration
item.description: LK Bennett has been bought out of administration by Gordon Brothers, the US firm behind Poundland’s rescue, putting the fashion brand’s nine UK shops and 380 jobs at risk. Read more: Poundland owner Gordon Brothers buys LK Bennett out of administration

item.title: National Wealth Fund to double investment pace with focus on clean energy and green steel
item.description: The National Wealth Fund plans to invest up to £5bn a year in clean energy, green steel and infrastructure, aiming to unlock £100bn for the UK economy and support 200,000 jobs. Read more: National Wealth Fund to double investment pace with focus on clean energy and green steel

item.title: UPS to cut 30,000 jobs as it accelerates shift away from Amazon deliveries
item.description: UPS plans to cut up to 30,000 jobs in 2026 as it continues to scale back low-margin Amazon deliveries, despite forecasting higher revenues for the year ahead. Read more: UPS to cut 30,000 jobs as it accelerates shift away from Amazon deliveries

item.title: YouTube criticised for pulling out of UK TV audience measurement system
item.description: YouTube has suspended its participation in the UK’s Barb audience measurement system, drawing criticism from broadcasters and advertisers over transparency and accountability. Read more: YouTube criticised for pulling out of UK TV audience measurement system

item.title: Aldi to open 40 new UK stores in 2026 as part of £370m expansion
item.description: Aldi plans to open 40 new UK stores in 2026 under a £370m investment, targeting towns without an Aldi as it works towards a long-term goal of 1,500 locations. Read more: Aldi to open 40 new UK stores in 2026 as part of £370m expansion
